needed.suggestion: Create a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian route parallel to the carriageway.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide carriageway.
Install dropped kerbs at the pedestrian crossing to allow wheelchair users and those with mobility aids to access the footway safely.
Enhance the visibility of the pedestrian crossing by adding more street lighting to ensure safety for all users, especially at night.
